description: ask the server to forget tasks
name: prune

description: copy a local file (or directory tree with -r) into the worktree
name: file_push

description: copy a worktree file (or directory tree with -r) to a local path
name: file_pull

description: list a single directory under the worktree (default: worktree root)
name: file_ls

description: create a directory in the worktree
name: file_mkdir

description: remove a file; -r a directory (dir_delete), -r -f a non-empty directory (RemoveAll); without -r a directory is refused
name: file_delete

description: the task's commits
name: git_log

description: counts revisions the way git does: none = unstaged, one = that revision
name: git_diff

description: one commit and its diff
name: git_show

description: uncommitted and untracked paths (untracked appear in no diff)
name: git_status

description: list the nested repositories under the worktree
name: git_subrepos

description: one file's whole content
name: git_file

description: list running execs; --task filters, --json emits JSON lines
name: exec_ls

description: stop one or more running execs by id (from `exec ls`)
name: exec_kill

description: list registered port forwards; --task filters, --json emits JSON lines
name: forward_ls

description: kill one or more registered forwards by id (from `forward ls`)
name: forward_kill

description: ask the server to reverse-dial RUNNER_CID
name: server_dial-runner

description: enroll a runner's public key: a runner signing with it may register
name: runner_enroll

description: list enrolled runner keys: label, when and by whom each was enrolled,
name: runner_keys

description: remove an enrolled key, named by a unique prefix of at least 8 hex
name: runner_unenroll

description: store a dial record: the server dials the runner (agent-runner --listen)
name: runner_dial_add

description: list dial records: state, the runner connected through each, the
name: runner_dial_ls

description: remove a dial record by its id (8 hex, from runner dial ls)
name: runner_dial_rm

description: make one runner leave, named by 8-32 hex of its identity (the id= column):
name: runner_kick

description: records every task the registry reports a forward for; --task narrows it to one.
name: workspace_save

description: delete one workspace from .harness/config (other workspaces and comments kept)
name: workspace_rm

description: list the workspaces in .harness/config
name: workspace_ls

description: print one workspace, or all of them when no name is given
name: workspace_show

description: declare a forward for a task in .harness/config; starts nothing
name: workspace_forward_add

description: drop a forward's declaration from .harness/config; stops nothing (the task block stays)
name: workspace_forward_rm

description: list every topic on the board with metadata (cap: board_observe)
name: board_topics

description: print retained messages for <topic> (text: header + pretty payload;
name: board_read

description: print retained messages arranged by reply chain, across topics (cap: board_observe).
name: board_thread

description: list each task's subscriptions; with <topic>, only the tasks a publish there reaches (cap: board_observe)
name: board_subscribers

description: withdraw one message: gone from every agent path, still readable here until the topic ages out (cap: board_purge)
name: board_retract

description: forget one contact of a task (--topic), or all of them; a forgotten route needs board_peer again until the task is addressed from it (cap: board_purge, scoped)
name: board_clear-contacts

description: drop the whole topic ring (seq=0) or one message by seq.
name: board_purge

description: keep <topic> past the board TTL and a server restart, on disk: --ttl <duration> counts from its last publish, --ttl forever never expires;
name: board_retain

description: empty a retained topic's in-memory ring; its disk log keeps every message and a restart does not load them back.
name: board_flush

description: freeze <topic>'s history up to now into an archive nothing appends to, kept until purged:
name: board_archive

description: list archives: id, source topic, the seq it runs through, messages, who made it, bytes on disk (cap: board_observe).
name: board_archives

description: subscribe <task> to <topic>, as its own agent subscribe would: only a topic the task could read itself; grants nothing (cap: board_member, scoped)
name: board_subscribe

description: drop <task>'s subscription to <topic>; on a member it is leave (cap: board_member, scoped)
name: board_unsubscribe

description: make <task> a member of <topic>: subscribed, may publish there, and its posts are answered on the topic unless it names --reply-to.
name: board_join

description: end <task>'s membership of <topic> and its subscription (cap: board_member, scoped)
name: board_leave

description: withdraw every message in ONE conversation from every agent-facing path,
name: board_retract-thread

description: destroy every message in ONE conversation, across all the topics it spans,
name: board_purge-thread

description: publish in the OPERATOR's name: the message is stamped sender=operator (cap: board_send).
name: board_send

description: wake every task subscribed to <topic>, exactly as a publish there would; publishes nothing (cap: board_send).
name: board_wake

description: open a detachable interactive PTY session (--repo: HARNESS_REPO_PATH)
name: session_new

description: inject input into a session (co-writer attach, no takeover); pair with snapshot to drive it statelessly
name: session_send

description: send one user turn to an event-stream session
name: session_stream_turn

description: send a notification (one short line)
name: notify

description: set THIS task's self-reported progress line (which task, which stage): one line, at most 256 bytes, no control characters
name: progress

description: publish a message. The body is the trailing words, or --data STRING, or --data - to read it from stdin.
name: agent_send

description: cancel a queued/running task
name: cancel

description: list runners and tasks: every task that has not ended, plus the 100 newest finished ones; --json emits one {runners,tasks} object
name: ls

description: snapshot live connections; -f streams live events; --json emits JSON lines
name: conns

description: sections: needs you, tasks, hosts, forwards, board -- each its count and at most three rows
name: overview

description: list the grantable --caps capability names and --scope forms
name: caps

description: name every embedded skill; the same as `skill --list`
name: skill_ls

description: show THIS connection's own principal + server-enforced caps and scope (no cap required)
name: whoami

description: print the embedded agent skill (default: harness-cli)
name: skill

description: the commit this binary — and the skills embedded in it — was built from
name: version

description: remove worktrees in <repo>/.harness-worktrees/
name: prune-local

description: with no ids (or --list): list what a prune forgot and could still be put back — ids, when they were pruned, and the repo/prompt that identify them. The ids live only in the server's WAL, so this is the only way to learn them
name: restore

description: re-grant a LIVE task's caps and/or scope; effective on its next request, no restart. The operator may rewrite any task; from inside a task, only your own descendants within your resume scope, bounded as a resume with the same flags would be
name: caps_set

description: list, per capability, the tasks holding it and the scope it reaches; --cap NAME adds the command that would revoke it
name: caps_audit

description: what a task reaches per capability, sees, and may hand down; whether it is wider than its parent
name: caps_reach

description: what a caps set (--cascade too), a spawn by the task (--spawn) or a set-parent (--parent / --parent-none) would change, and the command that does it; nothing is sent
name: caps_what-if

description: OPERATOR ONLY: re-point a LIVE task's parent link — the edge subtree scopes walk. --none detaches it to the operator root; --swap inverts it with its current parent. Caps and scope are untouched
name: caps_set-parent

description: JSON Lines: interactive sessions only. The rows share `ls --json`'s task
name: session_ls

description: cancel a session (alias of cancel)
name: session_kill

description: set a task's display name (shown as name= in ls and as the board sender label); an empty name clears it; at most 64 bytes of UTF-8 with no control characters
name: session_rename

description: list armed watchers: an agent sees the ones it armed, the operator every one; --task filters, --json emits JSON lines
name: session_await-idle_ls

description: disarm one or more watchers by id (from `session await-idle ls`, or the `watcher_id` an arm printed); nothing is delivered for a killed watcher, except `cancelled` to a caller still blocked on it
name: session_await-idle_kill

description: list armed progress watchers: an agent sees the ones it armed, the operator every one; --task filters, --json emits JSON lines
name: await-progress_ls

description: disarm one or more watchers by id (from `await-progress ls`, or the `watcher_id` an arm printed); the registry is shared with await-idle, so either kill takes either id
name: await-progress_kill

description: set a live session's PTY size; the server echoing the new size back IS the acknowledgement
name: session_resize

description: switch a running session between foreground and background; background needs --deadline (the run's deadline counts from the switch)
name: session_mode

description: list PTY records: each run's start, end, end reason, size on disk, expiry, truncation; with no task, every record you may view
name: record_ls

description: write one run's PTY record: the raw output, as session snapshot --raw prints it, or asciicast v2 (asciinema play)
name: record_get

description: delete a PTY record (record_delete); <task-id>#<n> for one run, or <task-id> --all-runs for every run
name: record_rm

description: change how long a record is kept after its run ends: longer needs record_persist, shorter record_delete
name: record_keep

description: start recording a live interactive session (record_persist); with no record yet the record starts from the session's replay buffer
name: record_on

description: stop recording a session (record_delete); the record stays
name: record_off

description: list the agent sessions recorded for a task's working directory (transcript_read): agent, id, times, size
name: transcript_ls

description: write one file of an agent session as the agent stored it, or with no file the whole session as a tar (transcript_read)
name: transcript_get

description: create a server-kept cron schedule: each firing resumes the schedule's background task (the first firing creates it, or --task binds one now)
name: schedule_new

description: change a schedule's future firings: only the flags named are changed (--cron or --tz recomputes the next firing; --task binds a task to a schedule with none)
name: schedule_edit

description: fire a schedule now, outside its times (recorded run_now); its next firing is unchanged. Needs the schedule_run capability and reach to the schedule's task, plus spawn before its task is created or resume or resume_exact over its bound task
name: schedule_run

description: delete a schedule; its task stays as an ordinary background task and a run in progress is not cancelled (cancel it to stop it)
name: schedule_rm

description: one row per schedule you can reach: id, cron + zone, next firing (in its zone), last outcome and age, task, agent, repo, prompt head. Needs no capability
name: schedule_ls

description: a schedule's definition, stored authority, history (last 50 firings) and the wait statistics over its runs. Needs no capability
name: schedule_show

description: on the host that will use the credential: generate an Ed25519 key pair, write the seed to --out (mode 0600, never overwritten) and print the public key (64 hex) for `credential new --pubkey`; the seed never leaves this host
name: credential_keygen

description: on the host that will use the credential, after `credential new --pubkey` / `credential rekey --pubkey` printed the task id: turn the seed file `credential keygen` wrote into the credential file `<task-id>:<seed>` (mode 0600, replaced atomically; the seed is never printed)
name: credential_bind

description: issue a credential task: an expiring identity for a script outside the harness, holding at most your own caps within your scope (needs credential_issue). It never holds credential_issue or schedule_edit
name: credential_new

description: give a credential a new key and a new expiry under the same id; the old key stops at once. Works on a live, revoked or expired one. Needs credential_issue, and the credential must be your own descendant (the operator: any)
name: credential_rekey

description: one row per credential task you can reach: id, status, name, expiry, last use (unknown after a server restart), caps and scope. Needs no capability
name: credential_ls

description: end a credential now (the existing cancel, refused for a task that is not a credential): its connections close and its next handshake is refused `revoked`. Needs cancel over it; `credential rekey` brings the id back with a new key
name: credential_revoke

description: print the session's current PTY screen as text (view attach; non-intrusive, works without a TTY)
name: session_snapshot

description: abandon the running TURN; the agent survives to take the next one
name: session_stream_interrupt

description: close the agent's stdin so it completes the turn in flight and exits 0
name: session_stream_finish

description: answer one pending tool request. The request id is the staleness guard: an answer aimed at a request that has gone is REFUSED, not applied to whatever is pending now
name: session_stream_approve

description: answer a QUESTION request (claude's AskUserQuestion) the agent is blocked on. A tool approval is `approve`; answers sent to one are refused
name: session_stream_answer

description: idempotent dump of subscribed topics; --since 0 (default) = the whole ring
name: agent_inbox

description: register a subscription
name: agent_subscribe

description: remove a subscription
name: agent_unsubscribe

description: list every topic on the board (JSON Lines) (cap: board_observe)
name: agent_topics

description: list the archives of one topic this task may read (JSON Lines; no cap). Read one with agent read --archive <id>.
name: agent_archives

description: list this agent's registered patterns (JSON Lines)
name: agent_subscriptions

description: list this agent's contacts, newest first (JSON Lines): reply routes it may publish to without board_peer because someone addressed it from there; at most 64, forgotten on server restart (no cap)
name: agent_contacts

description: list a topic's retained ring as metadata only, no payload (no cap)
name: agent_retained

description: print the calling task's side of the reply chain, across its subscribed topics (no cap).
name: agent_thread

description: drop a topic's retained buffer, or one message by seq (cap: board_purge)
name: agent_purge

description: fetch one retained message, whole; the hooks name it when they decline to inline a large body.
name: agent_read

description: withdraw a message YOU sent: gone from every agent path, still visible to the operator as retracted
name: agent_retract
